text:
Leafy Plus costs **$59/year** and auto-renews. Membership includes:

- Free Standard shipping with no minimum order (Express isn't free)
- Free change-of-mind returns (normally $6.95)
- A 90-day plant guarantee
- 10% member pricing on pots and accessories
- Early access to rare plant drops

If you cancel within **14 days** of purchase or renewal and haven't used any benefits, you get a full refund. After that, there's no refund, but your benefits continue until the end of the paid year.
